name: How can I maximize space during a small home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize space during a small home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing space in a small home renovation involves strategic planning and clever design choices. Consider built-in storage solutions like custom shelving or banquettes with hidden compartments. Opt for multi-functional furniture, such as ottoman storage or sofa beds. Light color palettes and ample lighting can make rooms feel larger and more open. Utilizing vertical space with tall shelving or cabinets, and incorporating sliding doors instead of traditional swing doors, can also significantly improve functionality and flow in compact areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small home space with built-in storage, multi-functional furniture, light colors, ample lighting, vertical storage, and sliding doors.
